description: Defines a thread-safe template class 'rnti_value_table' used for mapping RNTI identifiers to values, primarily used in MAC layer implementations for 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: rnti_value_table
classes.description: A thread-safe template class for mapping RNTI to values, supporting add, remove, and lookup operations.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Associates a given RNTI with a value, returning true if the RNTI was not previously registered.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes the specified RNTI from the table.

methods.name: nof_ues
methods.description: Returns an estimate of the number of UEs currently in the table.

methods.name: has_rnti
methods.description: Checks if a RNTI is registered in the table.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given RNTI.
